 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Los Angeles Chargers WR Tre' Harris (shoulder) fully participated in practice Saturday, Nov. 14, and is not on the injury report for Week 10.
 SOURCE: Omar Navarro – Chargers.com 
 Why It Matters: Harris has not been a big part of the passing game recently but could see more targets if Ladd McConkey is not able to play. He has a chance to be a No. 5 receiver in some fantasy leagues this week.
